evidence.finding: For each feasible finite-grid N/D candidate, solve the affordable Q upper bound continuously by bisection over the monotone cost function; choose Qmax for positive kappa and Q0 for nonpositive kappa.

The three g(Q) forms are increasing on the declared Q interval. q_upper_from_budget brackets [Q0,qmax], keeps lo as the feasible endpoint, and runs Q_BISECTION_ITERS=80 iterations before returning lo.
The selected candidate recomputes component costs with math.fsum and steps Q toward Q0 using np.nextafter until total cost is no greater than budget; infeasible candidates are omitted.
